source_note: Knowledge base entries transcribed from the supplied assignment data pack. No policies have been added, removed or reworded in meaning.

policies.title: Password Reset
policies.content: Employees can reset their own password using the self-service portal. If an account is locked out after 5 failed attempts, the employee must contact IT to have the account unlocked manually. No approval is required for a password reset.
key_points: Self-service portal is the standard path for a password reset.
Account lockout after 5 failed attempts requires IT to unlock the account manually.
No approval is required.

policies.title: VPN Access
policies.content: Full-time employees automatically receive VPN access. Contractors require manager approval through the access request form. VPN credentials expire every 90 days and the employee must renew their credentials.
key_points: Full-time employees receive VPN access automatically.
Contractors require manager approval through the access request form.
Credentials expire every 90 days.
The employee is responsible for renewing expired credentials.

policies.title: Laptop Replacement
policies.content: Laptops are eligible for replacement after 3 years of service, or earlier in case of verified hardware failure. Replacement requests should be raised at least 2 weeks before the intended replacement date.
key_points: Eligible for replacement after 3 years of service.
Earlier replacement is possible in case of verified hardware failure.
Raise the request at least 2 weeks before the intended replacement date.

policies.title: Software Installation
policies.content: Software that is part of the approved catalog can be self-installed by the employee. Software that is not in the approved catalog requires an IT Security review. The review takes 3 to 5 business days.
key_points: Approved catalog software can be self-installed.
Non-catalog software requires IT Security review.
IT Security review takes 3-5 business days.

policies.title: Printer Troubleshooting
policies.content: For printer issues, first check the printer queue, then restart the print spooler. If the issue persists, log a ticket with the printer asset tag.
key_points: Check the printer queue.
Restart the print spooler.
If the issue persists, log a ticket that includes the printer asset tag.

policies.title: Email Mailbox Quota
policies.content: The default mailbox quota is 25GB. Employees should archive old mail when nearing the quota. An increase beyond 25GB requires manager approval, up to a maximum of 50GB.
key_points: Default quota is 25GB.
Archive old mail when nearing the quota.
Increase beyond 25GB requires manager approval.
Maximum quota is 50GB.

policies.title: Guest Wi-Fi
policies.content: Guest Wi-Fi credentials are valid for 24 hours. Any employee can generate guest credentials from the front-desk kiosk. No IT ticket is required.
key_points: Guest credentials are valid for 24 hours.
Any employee can generate them at the front-desk kiosk.
No IT ticket is required.

policies.title: Expense Software
policies.content: Access to the expense software is granted by Finance, not IT. IT can only assist with login or technical issues once an account already exists.
key_points: Finance grants access to the expense software.
IT does not grant expense software access.
IT assists with login or technical problems on an existing account.

policies.title: Security Incident Reporting
policies.content: Suspected phishing emails, malware, or unauthorized access attempts must be reported immediately to security@veridian-corp.example. Such emails must not be forwarded to other employees.
key_points: Report suspected phishing, malware or unauthorized access immediately.
Report to security@veridian-corp.example.
Do not forward the suspicious email to other employees.

policies.title: Work-From-Home Equipment
policies.content: Employees working remotely more than 3 days per week are eligible for a one-time home-office equipment allowance. The request requires manager sign-off. Finance processes the allowance. IT only handles equipment shipping after approval.
key_points: Eligibility requires working remotely more than 3 days per week.
One-time home-office equipment allowance.
Manager sign-off is required.
Finance processes the allowance.
IT handles equipment shipping only after approval.

policies.title: Asset Management Policy Extract
policies.content: All company-issued hardware follows a standard 4-year refresh cycle from date of issue. Early replacement outside this cycle requires Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval.
key_points: Standard 4-year hardware refresh cycle from date of issue.
Early replacement outside the cycle requires Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval.
